text:
elaine: Hey team — PR ready for final review: https://github.com/redwoodinc/docs/pull/7892. CI/docs preview is up: https://preview.redwood.ai/ci/7892 — asking for legal + security eyes on the snippet in the SDK guide.

sam: quick scan — there's an example that shows a real-looking API key in the Node snippet (`const client = new Client({ apiKey: 'sk-...'} )`). We should redact or replace with a placeholder before merge. :exclamation:

ryan: @legal-team can you confirm if the privacy blurb under "Telemetry" is sufficient or needs rewording for GDPR customers?

legal-team: Thanks @ryan — we'll review. For the SDK snippet, please replace secrets with `REDACTED` or `YOUR_API_KEY` placeholder and include a short note about storing keys in KMS/HSM. Also add a one-line ownership tag: "Legal reviewed: <date>" in the PR desc.

docs-bot: docs-preview finished for PR #7892 — status: warnings (link-check) — 3 dead links detected in migration guide section. Preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/ci/7892/logs

nina: Link warnings are in the migration guide subsection for "Private deployments" — I can patch those. Also, FYI merging between 10–12 PT tends to trigger a flurry of preview builds. Can we schedule this merge for 14:00 PT so staging isn't overloaded?

kevin: I can remove the key and push a cleaned snippet in ~8 minutes. I'll also run the linkcheck locally to fix the migration links.

sam: thanks @kevin — once you push, I'll re-review the snippet. If the code is sanitized I'll approve.

ryan: legal-team any blockers on the telemetry wording?

legal-team: No blockers, just one suggested edit: change "we may collect" to "we collect" with reasons and retention period. I'll paste exact language in a reply to the PR.

kevin: pushed commit 5a1b3c to drop the sample key and swap with `YOUR_API_KEY`. Also removed the stray example that referenced an internal bucket.

docs-bot: docs-preview re-run started for commit 5a1b3c — status: running.

sam: re-reviewing now. The Node snippet looks good. Left one nit on phrasing in the example README line 42.

elaine: Plan: merge window at 14:00 PT tomorrow if legal posts their quip and CI is green. We'll do a canary doc publish first (deploy-bot will handle). If anything fails, postpone to next day.

legal-team: Posted exact telemetry wording in PR comment — LGTM.

docs-bot: docs-preview completed — status: pass (link-check warnings resolved). Preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/ci/7892/preview

deploy-bot: Canary publish scheduled at 14:00 PT (staging). Will notify on success/failure.

nina: small request — can we add a short note in the PR description about which customer-facing pages will change? Helps CS & marketing coordinate.

elaine: Good call. I'll update the PR desc with the list and mark @cs for awareness.

sam: approving on Github after the textual nit is fixed.

kevin: fixed the nit, pushed.

sam: approved ✅

elaine: Final checklist before merge: (1) legal ack (done), (2) docs-preview green (done), (3) deploy-bot canary scheduled (done), (4) CS notified (I updated PR). If no rollback alerts from canary, I'll merge at 14:05 PT.

ryan: thanks everyone. Small but important thread — nice coordinated flow. :thumbsup:

elaine: Merged at 14:07 PT after canary passed. Closing the loop here — added "Legal reviewed: 2026-03-15" to the PR and the redaction note in the SDK guide.

kevin: thanks — will follow up with a short changelog note for the release notes.

nina: noted for CS/marketing.

deploy-bot: Canary publish successful — no regressions detected. Full publish scheduled per release cadence.

legal-team: Thanks — archive this thread for audit.
